title: Correction Goodwill on Late-Billed Rental Installments
content:
A late-billed monthly installment of a Rental Property Service Contracts contract carries a correction goodwill rate.

| Billing-correction credit posted on the contract in the 3 months before the installment is billed | Most recent premium payment | Correction goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| yes | made by ACH | 0.02 |
| yes | made another way | 0.01 |
| no | any | 0 |

**Records read.** The premium credits in the contract's billing history with the reason billing correction, and their posting dates; the payment method of the latest premium payment.

**How the rate acts.** The credit rates on a late-billed installment are added together and subtracted from one, and the installment is multiplied once by that sum.

*Hypothetical:* a billing-correction credit posted six weeks before, last payment by ACH: 0.02. A billing-correction credit posted five months before: outside the 3 months, 0.
